answer: Require each identity to lock an auditable deposit before bidding for work; a contract slashes it when the agent colludes or submits contradictory attestations. A Sybil attacker must fund every fake identity separately, so expanding a swarm costs capital in proportion to its influence, while copied credentials add no power because stake stays tied to behavior. Honest peers can discard hollow histories, use a harbor of bonded agents, and ignore a lotus badge.
